name: MeetEdgar
description_en:
MeetEdgar is a hosted social publishing tool built around a reusable content Library, Categories, a recurring weekly Schedule and the resulting Queue. Instead of assigning every evergreen post its own date, a person assigns category/account time slots and lets the queue select eligible content. Manual sends, imported content and editable variations coexist with that recurring system.

The central evaluation is what gets reused, in what order and under what stopping conditions. X variations retire after one publication, seasonal categories require exclusion from random slots, and pausing the queue also blocks manually timed posts. Its documented history and click reporting help inspect past sends, but do not establish sales attribution or guaranteed reach. It is a candidate for small content teams with a substantial reusable library; account permissions, current format support and conflicting Use Once rules need attention before a real campaign. This profile is documentation research, not a publishing test.
description_zh:
MeetEdgar 是托管社交发布工具，围绕可复用内容 Library、Categories、循环周 Schedule 及生成的 Queue 工作。用户可为类别／账户指定时段，让队列选择合格内容，而不用逐篇为常青帖子指定日期。手工发送、导入内容、可编辑变体与循环系统共存。

评估核心是哪些内容会复用、顺序如何、何时停止。X 变体发布一次后退役，季节类别须排除随机时段，暂停队列也阻止手工定时帖。其历史及点击报告可检查过去发送，但不证明销售归因或保证触达。它适合拥有较多可复用素材的小内容团队；实际活动前需注意账户权限、当前格式及 Use Once 规则冲突。本档案是文档研究，未测试发布。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: USD Eddie $29.99/month or $299/year ($24.91 displayed monthly equivalent); Edgar $49.99/month or $499/year ($41.58 equivalent), taxes extra. Eddie includes 5 accounts, 10 weekly slots, 4 categories and 15 Inky credits; Edgar 25 accounts, 1,000 slots, unlimited categories and 50 credits. Both include unlimited scheduled posts and 20 team members; Social Inbox is Edgar-only. Inky consumes one credit per generated suggestion, resets every 30 days; 100 extra credits cost $2.50 and expire every 30 days. No permanent Free plan. Extra-account amounts vary by plan/term; confirm recurring checkout.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: USD Eddie 月付 $29.99 或年付 $299（页面月均 $24.91）；Edgar 月付 $49.99 或年付 $499（月均 $41.58），另加税。Eddie 含 5 账户、10 周时段、4 类别、15 Inky 点；Edgar 含 25 账户、1,000 时段、不限类别、50 点。两档均不限计划帖、含 20 团队成员，Social Inbox 仅 Edgar。Inky 每次生成建议消耗一点，每 30 天重置；另购 100 点 $2.50，每 30 天到期。无永久免费档。额外账户金额因档位／期限不同，需确认续费结算。

sections.title_en: The weekly schedule selects content rather than copying a calendar
sections.title_zh: 周排程选择内容，并非复制日历
sections.en: The Queue guide describes recurring category/account slots plus manual Send Now and Save or Schedule Send and Save. An empty queue can mean missing slots, missing library content or missing social-account associations. Its March 2026 rule is last in, first out, prioritizing newer library items; the general workflow agrees, while a March 2025 tutorial says FIFO. The discrepancy is retained rather than treating both as equivalent. Editorial example: create a Tips category and inspect the actual next queue entries before relying on a weekly slot. More content or fewer slots increases the interval before reuse.
sections.zh: Queue 指南描述循环类别／账户时段，以及手工 Send Now and Save、Schedule Send and Save。空队列可能因缺少时段、库内容或账户关联。2026 年 3 月规则是后进先出，优先较新内容；总体流程一致，但 2025 年 3 月教程说先进先出。此处保留差异，不把两者当等价。编辑示例：建立 Tips 类别后先检查真实下一队列项，再依赖周时段。增加内容或减少时段会拉长复用间隔。

sections.title_en: A variation changes the reusable asset and its destination behavior
sections.title_zh: 变体改变可复用素材及目的地行为
sections.en: Each variation can have its own link preview, images or video. Suggested text requires a caption link and generally English-readable page content; manually written versions remain possible when extraction fails. The guide orders the last-added variation first and rotates through different posts before the next variation, except when a category contains only one post. Facebook variations require manually entered Facebook text or only the preview/media publishes. X versions publish once and then become Expired for X; adding genuinely new variations reactivates them, while other destinations can continue recycling. Editorial review: inspect every caption and attachment before accepting generated variants.
sections.zh: 每个变体可用独立链接预览、图片或视频。建议文字需说明中有链接，且通常页面为可读英文；提取失败仍可手写。指南把最后添加的变体优先，先轮换不同帖子再发下一变体，类别只有一帖时例外。Facebook 变体需手工填写 Facebook 文字，否则仅预览／媒体发布。X 版本发布一次后标 Expired for X，添加真正新变体可重新启用，其他目的地可继续循环。编辑审阅建议：接受生成版本前检查每份说明及附件。

sections.title_en: Use Once has conflicting variation rules
sections.title_zh: Use Once 的变体规则存在冲突
sections.en: The June 25, 2026 Use Once article says a post remains active until it successfully publishes once to every selected account, then retires. It specifically discourages combining Use Once and Variations, saying only the last variation publishes. The January 29 Variations article instead says each variation publishes once before retirement. This conflict is unresolved; the newer, more specific warning prevents assuming the combination distributes every variant. Expiration can also end eligibility before all variations publish. Editorial limited-offer setup: use a simple controlled post and inspect its resulting queue rather than relying on variant completion.
sections.zh: 2026 年 6 月 25 日 Use Once 专页说帖子保持活动，直到每个所选账户各成功发布一次后退役。它明确不建议与 Variations 组合，说只发最后一个变体。1 月 29 日变体页却说各变体发一次后才退役，冲突未解决。较新且更具体警告意味着不能假设组合会投递全部版本。到期也可能在全部变体发布前结束资格。编辑限时优惠建议：使用简单可控帖子并检查生成队列，不依赖变体完成。

sections.title_en: Removing a seasonal slot is insufficient if random selection stays enabled
sections.title_zh: 若仍启用随机选择，只移除季节时段不够
sections.en: The seasonal-content guide first creates a separate category and excludes it from random scheduling. Add the category’s slots during the relevant period, then remove them when the season ends while retaining library assets. A post expiration date separately stops future publishing and grays the library item; editing/removing that date can reactivate it. The global Pause Queue guide says no Edgar posts publish while paused, including manually scheduled sends. Editorial emergency check: distinguish temporary account-wide pause from a permanent end date, and inspect queued time-sensitive posts before unpausing. Exact missed-slot catch-up behavior was not verified.
sections.zh: 季节指南先建立独立类别，并排除随机排程。在适用期间添加类别时段，结束后移除，同时保留库素材。帖子到期日另行停止未来发布并在库中灰显，修改／移除日期可重新启用。全局 Pause Queue 指南说暂停时不发布任何 Edgar 帖子，包括手工定时发送。编辑应急检查：区分临时全账户暂停与永久结束日期，恢复前检查队列限时帖。未核实错过时段的补发行为。

sections.title_en: Feed import is a daily intake with an explicit review choice
sections.title_zh: Feed 导入是每日入库，须明确选择审阅
sections.en: The January 2026 RSS guide imports available feed entries, checks once daily for new ones and lets setup choose social accounts, category, direct-to-library versus Pending and Use Once. A feed usually exposes recent entries rather than a complete website archive. Malformed or absent feeds need correction at the source. The Import FAQ says Instagram/Pinterest need attached media, and automatically imported Facebook text needs manual entry in its separate field. Editorial blog pipeline: import to Pending, verify title/link, add required media and Facebook copy, then release the reviewed content. RSS availability does not itself grant rights to republish someone else’s work.
sections.zh: 2026 年 1 月 RSS 指南导入 feed 可得条目，每日查新，并让设置选择账户、类别、直接入库或 Pending、Use Once。Feed 通常只提供近期条目，并非完整网站档案；缺失／格式错误需在来源修正。Import FAQ 说 Instagram／Pinterest 需附媒体，自动导入的 Facebook 文字需在独立栏手填。编辑博客流程：进入 Pending，检查标题／链接，补所需媒体及 Facebook 文字，再放行已审内容。RSS 可得不自动授予他人作品转载权。

sections.title_en: A collaborator is not documented as a restricted approver
sections.title_zh: 协作者并未被记录为受限审批者
sections.en: The team article, dated January 2022, grants invited collaborators all features except billing, allows up to 20 and says only the owner removes them; removed-member content transfers to the owner. Current pricing still includes 20 team members. This does not establish granular client isolation or a mandatory approver hierarchy. Connection refresh documentation adds native prerequisites: a LinkedIn Company Page requires the original connecting personal profile with Super Admin access, while Facebook Pages refresh through the connected personal profile. Editorial setup: verify the actual native administrator and collaboration scope before inviting a client or granting an operator access.
sections.zh: 2022 年 1 月团队文档授予受邀协作者除账单外全部功能，最多 20 人，仅所有者可移除，移除成员内容转给所有者。现行定价仍含 20 人，但不能据此确认精细客户隔离或强制审批层级。连接刷新文档另有原生条件：LinkedIn 公司页需原连接个人账户及 Super Admin，Facebook Pages 经关联个人账户刷新。编辑设置建议：邀请客户或授权操作者前核实实际原生管理员及协作范围。

sections.title_en: Refresh preserves content; deletion removes associations
sections.title_zh: 刷新保留内容，删除移除关联
sections.en: The January 2026 connection guide says refreshing retains scheduled/saved content and categories; deleting the social account removes its schedule and content associations irreversibly. After successful refresh, publishing resumes on the existing schedule. This is not confirmation that a previously failed send was replayed. The failure guide distinguishes rejected text/links, unsupported or temporarily unprocessed media, locked native accounts and excessive repetition; temporary media errors may warrant rescheduling. Editorial incident check: inspect native delivery and the stated cause before a controlled retry. No universal automatic retry interval or duplicate-prevention guarantee was established.
sections.zh: 2026 年 1 月连接指南说刷新保留计划／已存内容及类别，删除社交账户则不可逆移除其排程与内容关联。刷新成功后按已有排程恢复发布，不能证明此前失败发送已重放。故障指南区分文字／链接拒绝、媒体不支持或暂未处理、原生账户被锁、重复过密；临时媒体错误可能需重排。编辑故障检查：可控重试前检查原生投递及所示原因。未确认普遍自动重试间隔或防重复保证。

sections.title_en: Link clicks can arrive after the send
sections.title_zh: 链接点击可能晚于发送入账
sections.en: The History page links to native posts and individual performance, including variation publication times. Rebrandly-based click data imports once nightly, so missing same-day clicks should not automatically be treated as zero. The older Dashboard guide defaults to the previous week and groups total sends, shortened-link clicks and impressions by category/account. That is narrower than interpreting the marketing phrase real-time insights as continuous freshness for every metric. Editorial report: use the same dates and destination scope, check native post links, and label delayed or unavailable fields. Click comparisons are not a randomized test or revenue attribution.
sections.zh: History 链接原生帖子及单帖效果，含变体发布时间。基于 Rebrandly 的点击数据每夜导入一次，不能自动把当天缺失点击当零。较旧 Dashboard 指南默认上周，按类别／账户汇总发送、短链点击及展示。这比把营销的实时洞察解释成每项持续更新更窄。编辑报告建议：统一日期及目的地范围，检查原生帖子链接，标明延迟／不可得字段。点击比较并非随机实验或收入归因。

sections.title_en: Trial expiry and payment failure can change operational access
sections.title_zh: 试用到期及付款失败会改变运营访问
sections.en: Current pricing offers a 30-day trial and says the selected plan automatically charges afterward unless canceled; the homepage’s no-payment wording does not establish every checkout condition. Canceling retains access through the paid cycle. The January 2026 policy offers a prorated refund requested within the first 30 days of a billing cycle, after canceling and contacting support; it is not an automatic full refund. Failed charges are retried up to four times in a week, then the subscription cancels. Editorial offboarding: inspect renewal status and queued content before access ends; retention and post-cancellation publishing behavior remain unverified.
sections.zh: 现行定价提供 30 天试用，说明未取消会在结束后自动收所选计划费用；首页无需付款措辞不能确定所有结算条件。取消后可用至已付周期结束。2026 年 1 月政策提供账单周期前 30 天内申请的按比例退款，需先取消再联系支持，并非自动全退。扣款失败一周最多重试四次，之后取消订阅。编辑退出建议：访问结束前检查续费及队列，取消后保留和发布行为未核实。

seo.title_en: MeetEdgar: recurring queues, variation conflicts and recovery
seo.title_zh: MeetEdgar：循环队列、变体冲突及恢复
seo.description_en: Examine MeetEdgar category schedules, Use Once contradictions, seasonal controls, RSS review, account refresh and real billing conditions.
seo.description_zh: 核对 MeetEdgar 类别排程、Use Once 冲突、季节控制、RSS 审阅、账户刷新及真实计费条件。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate MeetEdgar evergreen content scheduling and stopping rules
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.
